metadata.name: Hourly atmospheric isotopic and water‑vapor measurements at a fixed Antarctic station (‑70.65°S, ‑8.25°W) 2017‑2019
metadata.description: The dataset comprises 17,133 hourly records from a single monitoring site in Antarctica (latitude -70.65°, longitude -8.25°, elevation 42 m). Each entry includes a timestamp, fixed site metadata (height, elevation, event), water‑vapor mixing ratio with its error, observation count (NOBS), isotopic ratios (δ¹⁸O‑H₂O, δD‑H₂O vapour), deuterium excess (d xs) with uncertainties, and a constant event label. Approximately 30 % of rows lack the full isotopic suite due to a documented instrument‑offline period.
